```swift
request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
```

segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let task = URLSession.shared.uploadTask(with: request, from: uploadData) { data, response, error in if let error = error { print ("error: \(error)") return } guard let response = response as? HTTPURLResponse, (200...299).contains(response.statusCode) else { print ("server error") return } if let mimeType = response.mimeType, mimeType == "application/json", let data = data, let dataString = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) { print ("got data: \(dataString)") } } task.resume() ```
